items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: Had never thought about Booker T. But I guess whatever Booker T means in his area, or meant in his area, yes.

ctx.x: And the song that came out at that time, no, I'll wait a little bit on that. So then they came into the studio. Did you see them at that point as being a New Orleans answer to Booker T and the MGs?
Had never thought about Booker T. But I guess whatever Booker T means in his area, or meant in his area, yes.
You know that emphasis on the organ instrumentals, piano instrumentals.
